subject: PrivOffer for MediTrace — SKU decomposition & channel fee evidence
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: PrivOffer: SKU decomposition & channel fee evidence request

Hi Irene, Ben —

We need to prepare a private-offer proposal for MediTrace (MDT-2026-103). They asked for a 12-month reserved capacity + metered inference add-ons model. Procurement is going to insist on both: (a) clear SKU decomposition for invoice pathing and (b) documented channel fee/commission logic for their reseller (CloudNest).

Key asks before I send the customer the initial economics:
- Confirm a recommended split (list price) between the Reserved GPU SKU and Metered Inference SKU for GCP private offer. We should show both list price and a committed discount ladder.
- Provide the reseller margin path: what portion of list price is eligible for pass-through to CloudNest and any capped commission tiers.
- Evidence pack for audit: short SOC2 pointers and the minimal ledger evidence they can include with procurement (they prefer not to request full invoices).

I've attached a draft MA plan with usage phasing and an initial margin workback (MediTrace_MA_plan_v1.xlsx, reseller_margin_workback_20260712.pdf). Can you review the margin numbers and the suggested cap on reseller commission (we've penciled 8% on the Reserved SKU and 10% on metered overage) and confirm if that is acceptable from finance/ops?

Timing: I want to get a vetted note to Alex by EOD tomorrow so procurement has something to review.

Thanks —
Naomi
Director, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- MediTrace_MA_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: committed nodehours, metered add-ons by month)
- reseller_margin_workback_20260712.pdf (PDF: finance workback)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivOffer: SKU decomposition & channel fee evidence request

Naomi —

Quick thoughts after a rapid pass:
- 8% on Reserved SKU looks tight but defensible if we hold discount headroom on reserved list price. Recommend we show a modeled commission ladder: 8% for first $250k, 6% for $250-750k, 4% > $750k (gives flexibility).
- For metered overage, 10% is fine but only on net token charges (i.e., after any platform discounts). We should call that out explicitly.
- Evidence: include the SOC2 summary (we can link rather than attach full report) plus a brief one-page ledger extract template that the customer can include in procurement packet. I recommend we add "SOC2 control mapping for data access" as a line item.

I'll update the margin_workback PDF with a second tab showing the ladder and send back by 2pm.

Ben
VP, Revenue Operations

Attachment referenced: reseller_margin_workback_20260712_v2.pdf (will follow)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garner <alex.garner@meditrace.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer proposal (summary) — Redwood x MediTrace (draft)

Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Attaching a short summary of the proposed Private Offer for MediTrace (see attached spreadsheet). High-level summary below so procurement has a quick read:

- Structure: 12-month Private Offer on GCP Marketplace. Two SKUs: Reserved Nodehours (monthly commitment) + Metered Inference (per-token inference add-ons).
- Pricing: Reserved SKU list price $X/nodehour (committed discount tiers applied per monthly billing). Metered priced at $Y per 1k tokens. See sheet for month-by-month phasing.
- Reseller (CloudNest) pass-through: We propose a commission ladder to CloudNest (8% first $250k; 6% $250-750k; 4% thereafter) on invoiced list price for the Reserved SKU. Metered overage has a 10% pass-through on net metered charges.
- Evidence for procurement: a short SOC2 pointer and an extract template for ledger proof — included as a zip in the attachments list; we can provide a redacted ledger for audit if CloudNest requires it.

Next steps: if the structure looks OK, I'd like to lock the private-offer price matrix and send DocuSign for signature. Ben/IR will confirm reseller ladder and provide the formal evidence pack.

Would you like us to present this to your procurement team tomorrow? If yes, please propose a time.

Best,
Naomi
Director, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- MediTrace_MA_plan_v1.xlsx
- reseller_margin_workback_20260712_v2.pdf
- SOC2-evidence-urls.txt

[NOTE: pricing numbers redacted in this thread summary — full sheet attached.]

From: Alex Garner <alex.garner@meditrace.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@meditrace.com>, procurement@meditrace.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer proposal (summary) — Redwood x MediTrace (draft)

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups from procurement: 

> On Mon, 12 Jul 2026 at 11:25 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com> wrote:
> 
> - Structure: 12-month Private Offer on GCP Marketplace. Two SKUs: Reserved Nodehours (monthly commitment) + Metered Inference (per-token inference add-ons).
> - Reseller (CloudNest) pass-through: We propose a commission ladder to CloudNest (8% first $250k; 6% $250-750k; 4% thereafter) on invoiced list price for the Reserved SKU. Metered overage has a 10% pass-through on net metered charges.

Procurement questions: 
1) We need clarity on whether the commission ladder is applied to list price or to Redwood net after discounts. They require an invoice path that shows the reseller commission on the customer-facing invoice (not as a separate credit).
2) For the ledger extract, what redaction can you do? We cannot share customer PII back to CloudNest, so the redacted example must remove any MediTrace-identifying rows.
3) What is the proposed glide path if actual usage lags the committed nodehours by >30% for any quarter — do we trigger true-up, or is there a smoothing mechanism?

If you can answer (1) and (3) in a short note, procurement can confirm we can move to signature. Also please send the DocuSign link and the final margin_workback PDF.

Regards,
Alex Garner
Head of Cloud Procurement
MediTrace

[Quoted earlier for context.]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garner <alex.garner@meditrace.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer proposal (summary) — Redwood x MediTrace (draft)

Alex —

Thanks — answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Commission ladder accounting: the ladder is applied to the customer-facing list price line items on the invoice. Practically we will show CloudNest as the reseller on the invoice metadata and the commission as a percentage applied to the Reserved SKU list line. We will also record the net settlement in our internal ledger. We will provide an invoice template showing the commission embedded in the line item (not as a separate credit).

2) Ledger redaction: we will provide a one-page redacted ledger extract that removes customer identifiers and any raw token strings. It will show: invoice date, SKU code, gross amount, commission percentage, commission amount. We will attach the redacted sample in the DocuSign room and provide SOC2 pointers via link (SOC2-evidence-urls.txt).

3) Usage smoothing / true-up: proposed approach — quarterly smoothing with one true-up at the 9-month mark if cumulative usage <70% of committed. If shortfall occurs, a prorated reconciliation is applied on the final invoice month. We can add a one-time 10% cushion that triggers automatically in month 1-3 to reduce clawbacks. Full details in the attached MA plan.

Attached: reseller_margin_workback_20260712_v2.pdf (final), MediTrace_MA_plan_v1.xlsx (updated with smoothing), SOC2-evidence-urls.txt

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/12345-MDT-PrivOffer

If this looks good, can we lock signature for tomorrow morning? Ben/Irene: Ben, please confirm the ladder and attach the final margin slide so I can include it in the DocuSign room. Irene, can you confirm the wording on reseller visibility in the invoice?

Thanks —
Naomi
Director, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

- reseller_margin_workback_20260712_v2.pdf
